anti_hardcoding_strategy.summary: All expected values are derived from JSON fixtures at test time. Only spec-contract literals (exception class names, log code strings, the substring 'sync') are inlined — and those are dictated by step1_requirements.json and the BDD feature file, not invented by tests.

Expected CVE ids and advisory ids extracted from osv_records[i]['id_field'] / scenario['expected_output']['vulnerabilities'], never inlined
CPE pollution exemplar tests iterate the entities fixture and compare against its embedded expected_post_sanitization_component

distinction_from_step4_atdd.rationale: Step 4 ATDD tests the public, integration-level contract grouped by business RULE (one test class per Rule block in the BDD feature). Step 5 unit tests cover internal class structure grouped by business CLASS (one test class per business class). The two are complementary — Step 4 proves 'does the right thing', Step 5 proves 'does it correctly internally'.

step2_bdd_scenarios.scenarios_covered_with_unit_tests: All 19 BDD scenarios — each major assertion in the feature file maps to one or more granular unit tests in this file. Step 5 also adds many tests BELOW the BDD level (helpers, attributes, internals).

step4_atdd_business.relationship_to_step5: Step 5 organizes tests by business CLASS (one Test* class per implementation class), whereas Step 4 organizes by business RULE. Step 5 tests are FINER granularity — they target single methods/branches/attributes; Step 4 tests target end-to-end public contracts.

fixture_strategy.tmp_path_usage: All sync() tests use pytest's tmp_path to write OSV/GHSA fixture JSON, avoiding any shared mutable filesystem state
fixture_strategy.no_network: Zero outbound HTTP imports in the test module. All caches synced from tmp_path JSON files only. Rule 4 (No Live Network In CI) enforced at test design time.
fixture_strategy.deterministic: All fixture data is committed to step1b_mock_entities.json and step1b_mock_scenarios.json; no timestamps, no random UUIDs in fixtures.

red_phase_guarantee.failure_mechanism: Import of step6_tdd_green_phase_business fails (module does not exist yet). _require_implementation() at the top of each test body issues a clean pytest.fail() with a precise message identifying the missing module and the expected exported classes.
red_phase_guarantee.verified_failure_result: 47 failed + 50 errors (97 total), zero passes, zero implementation present

required_exports: OPTIONAL: dataclass OSVSyncResult (test skips gracefully if absent)
key_invariants_step6_must_satisfy: EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper exposes _DISPATCH_TABLE class attribute with nvd_ecosystems / osv_ecosystems / ghsa_ecosystems bucket lists, and these buckets are pairwise disjoint
EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper exposes a _purl_type (or purl_type) static/classmethod helper that returns the type segment of a well-formed PURL and None/'' for malformed input
EcosystemVulnerabilityMapper exposes a _resolve_backend (or resolve_backend) helper returning 'nvd' | 'osv' | 'ghsa' | None
map_vulnerabilities accepts both (deps, cache) and (deps, cache=None) signatures
Output records carry source='nvd'|'osv'|'ghsa' (or backend='...') and a recognizable id field (cve_id, advisory_id, id_field, or id)
OSVCache and GHSACache constructors accept optional cache_path kwarg
lookup() before sync() raises a TYPED exception (NOT KeyError, NOT generic Exception) with message containing the substring 'sync'
sync() is idempotent — calling it twice does not duplicate records
OSVCache lookup honors SEMVER ranges: introduced..fixed (boundary fixed version is NOT vulnerable)
GHSACache lookup honors GIT ranges: introduced..fixed with version tags like v3, v3.4.0
CPESanitizer.sanitize_components returns a new list and does NOT mutate input components
CPESanitizer is table-driven: the nvd_ecosystems list in the dispatch_table dictates which components keep their cpe
CycloneDXSerializer and SPDXSerializer accept cpe_sanitize=bool with default False (backward-compat)
Unknown PURL type, missing-purl, and malformed-purl deps are skipped with a structured WARNING log entry (codes: dispatch.unknown_purl_type, dispatch.missing_purl, dispatch.malformed_purl)
No live-network imports (requests, httpx, urllib3) anywhere in the module
